question: In October 2021, 19-year-old ________ won the silver medal at the World Wrestling Championship.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anshu Malik.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anshu Malik:-**

 
 
• ​She won the silver medal in the** 57 kg category **at the **World Wrestling Championship** held in **Oslo, Norway.**
 
• She is a **young Indian wrestler** from **Haryana** who has been making waves in the wrestling world with her impressive performances in various **national and international tournaments.**
 
• Her **silver medal win **at the World Wrestling Championship is a significant achievement for her and a proud moment for India, as she is one of the** promising young talents** in the country's wrestling scene.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Seema Bisla**

 
 
• Seema Bisla is an Indian wrestler.
 
• She is a bronze medalist at the Asian Wrestling Championships and represented India at the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo, Japan.
 
• She lost her opening bout against Sarra Hamdi of Tunisia.
 
 
 
• **Sonam Malik:-**
 
 
• She is an Indian wrestler who represents Haryana.
 
• She is a two-time world junior champion and a three-time Asian medalist.
 
• She is the youngest Indian woman to qualify for the Olympics, doing so at the age of 18 in 2021.
 
 
 
• **Sanju Devi:-**
 
 
• She is an Indian women's freestyle wrestler who competes in the 62 kg weight class.
 
• She is a two-time World Junior Silver Medalist (2021, 2022) and a Commonwealth Games Silver Medalist (2022).
